profile.headline: Web Developer at Freelance, self-employed
profile.summary: Experienced Web Developer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Analytical Skills, PHP, Java, Javascript, HTML, and Scrum. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science focused in Math & Computer Science from HCM University of Natural Sciences.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Developed web applications including database design using MySQL, back-end development using PHP, Laravel, and front-end development using Javascript, Vuejs
•	Designed software architecture and integrated web applications with other systems/services such as Wowza, Camunda, Mailgun, Fattmerchant, Pusher, Elasticsearch based on project functional requirements; successfully launched 3 web applications
•	Designed and developed back-end of mobile application, enabling clients to schedule meetings with customers; successfully integrated version 1 which engaged clients to renew a contract for 2nd version upgrade 
•	Created 2 new prototypes of video chat web application successfully and won a project to develop a product

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Phu Nhuan Dist., Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
positions.description:
•	Developed one PL/SQL batch script from scratch to verify billions stock options trading records based on the regulatory rule from SEC (U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission)
•	Led 7+ engineers to update 50+ PL/SQL batch scripts in one month by using a batch script to analyze source codes and working closely with QA Engineers and Database Administrators
•	Converted one PL/SQL batch script to SQL92 for migrating batch scripts from PL/SQL to Hive and Hadoop

positions.title: Java Developer
positions.locationName: Hai Au Building 10th Floor, 39B Truong Son Str., Ward 4, Tan Binh Dist., Ho Chi
positions.description:
•	Developed CRM application with Agile teams using Java, J2EE, EJB, Hibernate, SQL and Xper.ivy business process management platform
•	Monitored and configured Hudson ensuring the continuous integration system worked correctly 
•	Researched and made a prototype for text search feature using Lucene and transferred to other development teams
•	Proposed full-text search architecture by researching on Solr related architecture from big companies such as IBM

company.name: Axon Active Vietnam - Agile Offshore Software Development Company

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: Tan Binh Dist., Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam
positions.description:
•	Used Actionscript open source to build Flash-based multi-upload plugin integrated to a webmail system 
•	Designed code structure based on plugin pattern to help the team build an online image editor and complete the project one week before the deadline
•	Used Actionscript to successfully build image filter, WYSIWYG plugin and made prototypes for company webmail system product
•	Achieved 2nd rank in annual performance review in the R&D department with 15 staff

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Developed and deployed process management solutions including hardware and software for 8 governmental offices 
•	Set up and replaced the company’s version control system from Visual Source Safe to Subversion, increasing the efficiency to manage source code of the company
•	Involved in software development cycle including collecting customer requirements, developing web applications using ASP, PHP, Javascript, MS SQL, training customers to use the applications
•	Researched and proposed bug tracker system to manager
